digest.component_or_area: Completion verifier banking and verdict assembly
propositions: At search exhaustion, BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE currently banks met=false (refutation) when it should distinguish insufficient evidence (search budget exhausted before determination) from genuine refutation (evidence positively contradicts criterion).

Completion verifier framework must carry evidence_sufficient:false marker alongside met:false to distinguish absence-of-evidence from evidence-of-absence, preventing false FAIL verdicts on tickets whose evidence exists but was unreachable within budget constraints.

Banking write path (fallback_record, upsert, record_criterion_verdict) must widen to support tri-state outcomes: met=true, met=false with evidence_sufficient:false (insufficient), and met=false without marker (refuted).

Verdict consumers (close gate, renderers, audit page, sidecar) must become marker-aware to report insufficiency accurately and steer operators away from anti-pattern workarounds (tagging code-verifiable criteria [operator-attested] to bypass exhausted searches).
